runtime/net#

The native layer under net/ip, net/multicast, net/tcp, net/udp: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under net/ip, net/multicast, net/tcp, net/udp: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

Private numeric address conversion through the existing core.net provider. These two declarations do not resolve hostnames or allocate sockets. Their versioned endpoint envelope is consumed and validated only inside net/ip; application code uses IpAddress and receives plain packed address bytes.
